svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_checker Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_checker:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This monitor monitor_checker class is used to check received packet in monitor from the serial lane receiver. It checks packet fields like transmission mode, checksum and virtual channel ID etc.
